Aegis.name: Aegis of Light
Aegis.desc: Briefly protect yourself and allies by invoking your faith. Praise the light!

AerialShot.name: Aerial Shot
AerialShot.desc: Leap through the air and fire downward, striking enemies below before landing with evasive grace.

Agility.name: Inner Focus
Agility.desc: Sharpen your focus and reflexes, increasing AGI and DEX for a short time.

AngelicBlessing.name: Angelic Blessing
AngelicBlessing.desc: The summon radiates angelic grace, increasing healing received by nearby allies.

ArcaneSigil.name: Arcane Sigil
ArcaneSigil.desc: Push your magic beyond safe limits, increasing Magic Attack and Cast Speed at the cost of higher MP use.

Armored.name: Armored
Armored.desc: The summon radiates protective armor, increasing nearby allies' All Resistance while shielding itself with Protection.

ArrowShower.name: Arrow Shower
ArrowShower.desc: Rain arrows over a wide area, striking enemies repeatedly and forcing them to scatter.

AutoAttack.name: Auto Attack
AutoAttack.desc: Perform an auto attack against the target.

AxeArc.name: Twin Cleave
AxeArc.desc: Swing twice in wide arcs, cutting through enemies in front of you.

AxeThrow.name: Axe Throw
AxeThrow.desc: Hurl your axe in a brutal arc, striking the target before it snaps back into your grasp.

AxeVortex.name: Vortex Slash
AxeVortex.desc: Unleash a spinning slash that damages nearby enemies and pulls them toward you.

Barrier.name: Sacred Aegis
Barrier.desc: Wrap an ally in divine protection, forming a barrier based on their maximum health.

Bash.name: Bash
Bash.desc: Smash the target with a crushing blow, with a chance to stun them.

Berserk.name: Berserk
Berserk.desc: Enter a reckless battle state, greatly increasing combat power while abandoning restraint.

BladeDance.name: Blade Dance
BladeDance.desc: Unleash a flurry of strikes around you, cutting down nearby enemies in rapid motion.

BleedCoating.name: Red Maw
BleedCoating.desc: Empower your attacks with jagged strikes, giving them a chance to apply Bleeding.

Blessing.name: Benediction
Blessing.desc: Bless nearby allies with divine protection, raising all attributes for a short time.

Blink.name: Blink
Blink.desc: Teleport to a target location, slipping out of danger and repositioning with precision.

BloodCrash.name: Blood Crash
BloodCrash.desc: Spend stored Rage to recover health instantly and keep regenerating for a short time.

BloodFrenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
BloodFrenzy.desc: Give in to relentless violence, trading control for speed, pressure, and sustain.

BloodLust.name: Blood Lust
BloodLust.desc: The summon radiates bloodlust, granting nearby allies HP siphon while giving itself Multistrike.

BoneSpear.name: Bone Spear
BoneSpear.desc: Hurl a sharpened lance of bone that pierces through flesh and spirit alike.

BoneSpikes.name: Bone Spikes
BoneSpikes.desc: Rupture the ground with jagged bone spikes, impaling enemies caught above them.

Bonk.name: Bonk!
Bonk.desc: Deliver an absurdly powerful bonk to the target. Some lessons require blunt force.

ChainLightning.name: Chain Lightning
ChainLightning.desc: Unleash lightning that jumps between enemies, shocking each target it chains through.

Cloaking.name: Cloaking
Cloaking.desc: Blend into shifting shadows, hiding from sight until you attack, cast, or take a hit.

Combustion.name: Combustion
Combustion.desc: Detonate unstable flames around the target, dealing Fire magic damage and applying Burning.

Conjurer.name: Conjurer
Conjurer.desc: Deepen your bond with summoned allies, improving summon damage and healing power.

ConsecratedGround.name: Consecrated Ground
ConsecratedGround.desc: Bathe the ground in holy light, burning enemies who remain within the consecrated area.

Consecration.name: Consecration
Consecration.desc: Drop a pillar of light that purifies the surrounding area, burning the unworthy and healing the righteous.

Conviction.name: Conviction Aura
Conviction.desc: Radiate unwavering resolve, increasing nearby allies' Melee, Ranged, and Magic damage.

CorpseBarrier.name: Corpse Barrier
CorpseBarrier.desc: Bind stolen bone and life into a grim barrier, shielding yourself through your summon.

CorpseExplosion.name: Corpse Explosion
CorpseExplosion.desc: Detonate a Bonekin summon in a burst of necrotic force, causing nearby enemies and summons to explode on death.

CorpseExplosionEnemy.name: Corpse Explosion
CorpseExplosionEnemy.desc: Mark an enemy with corpse magic, causing them to erupt with decay when death claims them.

CorpseExplosionSummon.name: Corpse Explosion
CorpseExplosionSummon.desc: Mark a summon with corpse magic, causing it to explode when destroyed.

Counter.name: Counter Stance
Counter.desc: Raise your guard and counter. Blocks attacks and hits back with a stunning blow!

CounterSlash.name: Counter Slash
CounterSlash.desc: Release a retaliatory strike, stunning enemies caught in the force of your counter.

CrimsonFrenzy.name: Crimson Frenzy
CrimsonFrenzy.desc: Rip into the target with a savage follow-up strike after landing a critical hit.

CrushingAdvance.name: Crushing Advance
CrushingAdvance.desc: Turn your charge into a rallying surge, granting nearby allies Might and Protection.

Cure.name: Cure
Cure.desc: Purify an ally with holy clarity, protecting them from Poison, Blind, and Silence.

CureAll.name: Mass Cure
CureAll.desc: Purify nearby allies, removing Poison, Blind, and Silence while granting brief immunity.

Cyclone.name: Cyclone
Cyclone.desc: Spin forward in a violent cyclone, pulling enemies inward and shredding them with repeated strikes.

Damnation.name: Damnation
Damnation.desc: Call down holy judgment, damaging enemies and leaving them exposed to both physical and Magic punishment.

Dark Exorcism.name: Dark Exorcism
Dark Exorcism.desc: Twist sacred rites into shadow magic, pulling enemies inward before tearing through them with corrupted force.

DarkClaw.name: Dark Claw
DarkClaw.desc: Rip into the target with savage slashes, causing Bleeding while fueling your Rage.

DeathBond.name: Death Bond
DeathBond.desc: Bind yourself to an ally, sharing healing and HP siphon between both bonded souls.

DeathBramble.name: Necrotic Presence
DeathBramble.desc: The summon radiates necrotic power, empowering nearby allies' Undead damage while weakening enemies.

DeathBrambleEnemy.name: Necrotic Presence Enemy
DeathBrambleEnemy.desc: A necrotic aura weakens nearby enemies against undead power.

DeathCoil.name: Death Coil
DeathCoil.desc: Unleash a coil of undead energy, harming enemies while restoring summoned allies.

DeathCoilEnemy.name: Death Coil
DeathCoilEnemy.desc: Strike enemies with undead energy, damaging them and leaving Decay behind.

DeathCoilSummon.name: Death Coil
DeathCoilSummon.desc: Mend a summoned ally with undead energy, restoring its strength through dark power.

DeathNova.name: Death Nova
DeathNova.desc: Release a burst of necrotic force, rotting nearby enemies and leaving a decaying field behind.

DeathNovaField.name: Death Nova Field
DeathNovaField.desc: A lingering necrotic field damages enemies over time, spreading Decay and Desecration.

DeathSpiral.name: Death Spiral
DeathSpiral.desc: Spin into a scythe assault, carving nearby enemies while spreading Decay through each strike.

DecayAura.name: Decay Aura
DecayAura.desc: Toggle a withering aura that decays nearby enemies and weakens their healing.

Defiance.name: Defiance Aura
Defiance.desc: Radiate unyielding faith, reducing incoming damage for nearby allies.

Deflect.name: Deflect
Deflect.desc: Brace yourself with quick protection, raising your chance to block the next attack.

Dispell.name: Absolution
Dispell.desc: Strip the target clean of buffs and harmful statuses, returning them to a neutral state.

DivinePunishment.name: Divine Punishment
DivinePunishment.desc: Channel your divine might and rain down radiant swords on your unworthy foes!

Divinity.name: Divinity
Divinity.desc: Radiate divine power, strengthening nearby allies while empowering your own healing and holy protection.

EarthBarrier.name: Avatar of Stone
EarthBarrier.desc: Mastery over earth lets you assume this avatar state. Increasing earth damage, while making you more resistant to attacks.

Earthbolt.name: Earthbolt
Earthbolt.desc: Strike a single foe with crushing Earth magic and attune yourself to Earth.

Earthquake.name: Earthquake
Earthquake.desc: Shake the battlefield with violent tremors, stunning enemies caught in the upheaval.

EarthSpikes.name: Earth Spikes
EarthSpikes.desc: Rupture the ground with jagged stone, striking enemies and leaving them exposed to Fire.

EarthWall.name: Earth Wall
EarthWall.desc: Raise a wall of solid stone, blocking space and shaping the battlefield around you.

EclipsingAegis.name: Eclipsing Aegis
EclipsingAegis.desc: Place an evolving barrier on an ally, absorbing damage before erupting with sacred power.

EnchantArmorHoly.name: Sanctify
EnchantArmorHoly.desc: Bless an ally's armor with holy light, changing their armor element to Holy.

EnchantEarth.name: Enchant Earth
EnchantEarth.desc: Imbue your attacks with the Earth element.

EnchantFire.name: Enchant Fire
EnchantFire.desc: Imbue your attacks with the Fire element.

EnchantHoly.name: Enchant Holy
EnchantHoly.desc: Imbue your attacks with the Holy element.

EnchantPoison.name: Enchant Poison
EnchantPoison.desc: Imbue your attacks with the Poison element.

EnchantShadow.name: Enchant Shadow
EnchantShadow.desc: Imbue your attacks with the Shadow element.

EnchantUndead.name: Enchant Undead
EnchantUndead.desc: Imbue your attacks with the Undead element.

EnchantWater.name: Enchant Water
EnchantWater.desc: Imbue your attacks with the Water element.

EnchantWind.name: Enchant Wind
EnchantWind.desc: Imbue your attacks with the Wind element.

EndowHoly.name: Endow Holy
EndowHoly.desc: Bless an ally's weapon with holy light, converting them to the Holy element.

Endure.name: Endure
Endure.desc: Steel yourself against incoming hits, increasing defenses and preventing flinching.

EnergyShield.name: Energy Shield
EnergyShield.desc: Wrap yourself in arcane protection, redirecting part of incoming damage to MP.

Execute.name: Execute
Execute.desc: Deliver a brutal finishing blow, dealing heavy damage and feeding your Rage.

Exorcism.name: Exorcism
Exorcism.desc: Call down sacred radiance over an area, pulling enemies inward before blasting them with holy power.

ExplosiveGrenade.name: Explosive Grenade
ExplosiveGrenade.desc: Hurl an explosive charge that detonates in flames, knocking back and burning enemies.

Fanaticism.name: Fanaticism
Fanaticism.desc: Radiate holy zeal, quickening nearby allies while making your own strikes more relentless.

FanFire.name: Fan Fire
FanFire.desc: Rapidly unload a burst of shots into one target, building momentum for follow-up fire.

FanOfKnives.name: Fan Of Knives
FanOfKnives.desc: Scatter a fan of spectral blades, leaping through danger while setting up your next technique.

Ferocity.name: Ferocity
Ferocity.desc: The summon radiates raw ferocity, increasing nearby allies' Attack and Magic Attack.

FieldCurse.name: Banishment Field
FieldCurse.desc: Call down a cursed field that twists healing against enemies and leaves them exposed to Magic damage.

FieldDamage.name: Dissonance Well
FieldDamage.desc: Create a dissonant field that damages enemies and slows their movement, attacks, and casting.

FieldHealing.name: Resonance Well
FieldHealing.desc: Create a soothing well of resonance, healing allies who remain within its gentle hum.

FieldSilence.name: Suppression Field
FieldSilence.desc: Create a silent field that pulls enemies inward and may seal their ability to cast.

Fireball.name: Fireball
Fireball.desc: Launch a fiery orb that explodes on impact, burning enemies and leaving a Firewall behind.

FireBarrier.name: Avatar of Fire
FireBarrier.desc: Mastery over Fire lets you assume this avatar state. Increasing Fire damage, Healing Received, and igniting those that dare attack you.

Firebolt.name: Firebolt
Firebolt.desc: Launch a concentrated bolt of Fire at one enemy and attune yourself to Fire.

FireField.name: Flame Ground
FireField.desc: Leave burning ground behind, scorching enemies who remain in the flames.

FirePillar.name: Fire Pillar
FirePillar.desc: Summon a pillar of flame from the ground, burning enemies and exposing them to Earth.

FireRelease.name: Fire Release
FireRelease.desc: Call forth a blazing spirit that crashes down in flames and leaves your attacks wreathed in Fire.

Firewall.name: Firewall
Firewall.desc: Create a lingering wall of flame that burns enemies and pushes them back.

FlameOrb.name: Flame Orb
FlameOrb.desc: Send out a slow orb of unstable flame that erupts into a wide explosion on impact.

FlameOrbExplosion.name: Flame Explosion
FlameOrbExplosion.desc: Detonate stored flame in a wide burst, burning enemies caught in the blast.

FlashBang.name: Flash Bang
FlashBang.desc: Backslide out of danger and prepare a flash grenade for your next move.

FlashGrenade.name: Flash Grenade
FlashGrenade.desc: Throw a blinding grenade that stuns and disorients enemies caught in the blast.

FlowState.name: Flow State
FlowState.desc: Enter a focused combat rhythm, turning auto attacks into Magic pressure and improving autocast flow.

ForceShot.name: Force Shot
ForceShot.desc: Fire a powerful shot that knocks enemies back and sets up a combo finisher.

FreezeGrenade.name: Freeze Grenade
FreezeGrenade.desc: Throw a freezing charge that bursts in an area, immobilizing enemies caught inside.

FreezingEdge.name: Frost Rounds
FreezingEdge.desc: Coat your attacks in frost, giving them a chance to apply Frozen.

FreezingField.name: Blizzard
FreezingField.desc: Unleash a barrage of hail, knocking back foes with the might of ice. A slick spell to keep enemies away.

FrostBlade.name: Binding Spiral
FrostBlade.desc: Spin with collapsing force, dragging enemies inward before freezing those caught at the center.

FrostBladeExplosion.name: Spiral Collapse
FrostBladeExplosion.desc: Collapse the spiral into a freezing burst, locking nearby enemies in ice.

Frostglass.name: Frostglass
Frostglass.desc: Shatter frozen magic around the target, dealing Water damage and applying Slow.

FrozenGround.name: Frozen Ground
FrozenGround.desc: Freeze the ground beneath enemies, damaging them repeatedly with a chance to leave them Frozen.

FuryBond.name: Fury Bond
FuryBond.desc: Bind an ally with volatile force, granting Fury and Might through a shared battle surge.

GainRage.name: Gain Rage
GainRage.desc: Build Rage through battle, feeding your next brutal technique.

GameMasterCloaking.name: Game Master Cloaking
GameMasterCloaking.desc: If you can see this message, you are either a Game Master yourself, or someone looking in the game files!

Grace.name: Divine Grace
Grace.desc: Bless nearby allies with divine grace, greatly improving natural HP and MP recovery.

GrandCross.name: Grand Cross
GrandCross.desc: Burst forth a radiant cross along the ground, purging a wide area of the unworthy with your holy righteousness!

GraveChill.name: Grave Chill
GraveChill.desc: The summon radiates graveborn cold, hastening nearby allies while chilling nearby enemies.

GraveChillEnemy.name: Grave Chill Enemy
GraveChillEnemy.desc: A chilling aura slows nearby enemies, sapping their Move Speed and Attack Speed.

GroundSlam.name: Earth Splitter
GroundSlam.desc: Slam the ground with heavy force, staggering enemies and setting them up for your next combo.

GuardianBond.name: Guardian Bond
GuardianBond.desc: Bind an ally with guardian magic, granting Vitality and Regeneration through a shared bond.

GuardianSpirit.name: Guardian Spirit
GuardianSpirit.desc: Conjure a guardian spirit around an ally, shielding them from ranged attacks.

Harvest.name: Harvest
Harvest.desc: Leap forward with a wide scythe swing, staggering enemies and opening them to a finishing strike.

Haste.name: Haste
Haste.desc: Bless an ally with swiftness, clearing Slow and increasing Move Speed and Attack Speed.

HasteAll.name: Mass Haste
HasteAll.desc: Bless nearby allies with swiftness, clearing Slow and increasing Move Speed and Attack Speed.

Heal.name: Heal
Heal.desc: Channel holy energy into an ally, restoring HP and leaving gentle Regeneration behind.

HealAll.name: Mass Heal
HealAll.desc: Release a wave of holy energy, healing nearby allies and leaving Regeneration behind.

HeavySwap.name: Heavy Loadout
HeavySwap.desc: Ready a dedicated heavy weapon and swap to it mid-battle to unleash overwhelming firepower. Unlocks Gatling Guns and Launchers

HighGuard.name: High Guard
HighGuard.desc: Become an impenetrable fortress, increasing Block while becoming difficult to move.

HighHeal.name: High Heal
HighHeal.desc: Pour intense holy power into an ally, restoring a massive amount of HP.

HolyLight.name: Holy Light
HolyLight.desc: Release focused divine light at a single enemy, striking them with Holy force.

HolyShield.name: Holy Shield
HolyShield.desc: May the light bless your shield, increasing Block and All Resistance against all your foes!

HolyWrath.name: Holy Wrath
HolyWrath.desc: Smite an area with concentrated holy power, silencing enemies and leaving wrathful light behind.

HolyWrathField.name: Litany of Wrath
HolyWrathField.desc: Call down lingering Holy wrath, stunning enemies and exposing them to Magic damage.

HydroVortex.name: Hydro Vortex
HydroVortex.desc: Unleash a violent spiral of water, dragging enemies inward and exposing them to Wind.

Icebolt.name: Icebolt
Icebolt.desc: Ice to meet you! As you hurl a Water shard at your foes.

IceRelease.name: Ice Release
IceRelease.desc: Call forth a spectral pufferfish that fires icy shards, slowing foes and readying your next spell.

IceShard.name: Ice Shard
IceShard.desc: This spell is a great ice breaker as you send an ice spike that shatters and freezes your foes.

Invoker.name: Invoker
Invoker.desc: Enter an invoker state, empowering your summons to echo Soul Strike with their own Magic.

JudgementBlade.name: Judgement Blade
JudgementBlade.desc: This giant Holy sword cleaves through the unworthy, slowing them for further attacks.

JumpShot.name: Jump Shot
JumpShot.desc: Leap into battle and fire mid-air, staggering enemies and opening them to a follow-up shot.

LifeBond.name: Life Bond
LifeBond.desc: Link your life to an ally, taking their wounds upon yourself through a sacred bond.

LifeDrain.name: Life Drain
LifeDrain.desc: Siphon vitality from enemies, or empower a summon with a dangerous undead surge.

LifeDrainEnemy.name: Life Drain
LifeDrainEnemy.desc: Drain life from enemies with undead power, restoring yourself through the damage dealt.

LifeDrainSummon.name: Life Drain
LifeDrainSummon.desc: Empower a summoned ally with undead frenzy, increasing its aggression at a dangerous cost.

LightningCoat.name: Lightning Coat
LightningCoat.desc: The summon radiates crackling energy, increasing nearby allies' Attack Speed and Flee.

LightningReflexes.name: Lightning Reflexes
LightningReflexes.desc: Move like living lightning, increasing speed and evasive combat instincts.

LightningRelease.name: Lightning Release
LightningRelease.desc: Unleash a phoenix of lightning that streaks forward, piercing enemies in its path.

LightningStrike.name: Flash Step
LightningStrike.desc: Cross the battlefield in an instant, striking the target area with sudden force.

LimitBreak.name: Limit Break
LimitBreak.desc: Push beyond safe limits, gaining overwhelming power while sacrificing defense and recovery.

Lockdown.name: Lockdown
Lockdown.desc: Lock your heavy weapon in place, unleashing sustained fire while holding your ground.

Marked.name: Mark Target
Marked.desc: Mark a target's weak points, reducing their Flee and Critical Defense.

Meteor.name: Meteor
Meteor.desc: Call down a burning meteor, stunning enemies and leaving them scorched in the blast.

MeteorStorm.name: Meteor Storm
MeteorStorm.desc: Call down a lingering storm of meteors, raining Fire damage across the targeted area.

MimicSeal.name: Mimic Seal
MimicSeal.desc: Seal a target's magic and copy its essence, allowing you to cast the spell as your own.

Mount.name: Mount
Mount.desc: Mount your active companion and increase your Move Speed while outside of combat.

MountMastery.name: Gryphon Riding
MountMastery.desc: Call upon your holy gryphon, taking to the battlefield as both rider and radiant blade.

NPC_Berserk.name: Berserk
NPC_Berserk.desc: Drive yourself into a wild rage, increasing offensive power through pure fury.

NPC_BleedAttack.name: Bleed Attack
NPC_BleedAttack.desc: Rip into the target with a bleeding strike that leaves lasting wounds.

NPC_Blind.name: Blind
NPC_Blind.desc: Cloud the target's sight, reducing their ability to fight with accuracy.

NPC_Burn.name: Burn
NPC_Burn.desc: Scorch the target with Fire magic and leave them Burning over time.

NPC_Enrage.name: Enrage
NPC_Enrage.desc: The monster flies into a deadly rage, greatly increasing Auto Attack damage, Attack Speed, Cast Speed, and Move Speed.

NPC_Enrage_2.name: Last Stand
NPC_Enrage_2.desc: The monster makes a desperate stand, gaining strong All Resistance and HP siphon for a short time.

NPC_Freeze.name: Freeze
NPC_Freeze.desc: Strike the target with freezing magic, applying Frozen.

NPC_Knockback.name: Stun
NPC_Knockback.desc: Knock the target back with force, briefly stunning them on impact.

NPC_LightningReflexes.name: Lightning Reflexes
NPC_LightningReflexes.desc: The enemy surges with lightning reflexes, greatly increasing Attack Speed and Flee.

NPC_ManaLeech.name: Mana Drain
NPC_ManaLeech.desc: Strike an enemy with draining force, stealing MP through the attack.

NPC_Poison.name: Gunk Shot
NPC_Poison.desc: Fire a toxic shot that applies Poison to the target.

NPC_Pull.name: Pull
NPC_Pull.desc: Drag the target inward with force, briefly stunning them on impact.

NPC_ShadowStep.name: Shadow Step
NPC_ShadowStep.desc: The enemy slips through shadow, appearing behind its target for a sudden strike.

NPC_Sharpen.name: Sharpen
NPC_Sharpen.desc: The enemy sharpens its focus, greatly increasing critical chance for a short time.

NPC_Silence.name: Silence
NPC_Silence.desc: Seal the target's voice, preventing them from casting skills.

NPC_SpellGuard.name: Spell Shield
NPC_SpellGuard.desc: The enemy raises a spell shield, reflecting hostile Magic back at its source.

NPC_SpikedShell.name: Thorns
NPC_SpikedShell.desc: The enemy hardens with thorns, reflecting physical damage back at attackers.

NPC_SteelGuard.name: Reinforce
NPC_SteelGuard.desc: The enemy reinforces its guard, greatly increasing block chance for a short time.

NPC_Stun.name: Stun Attack
NPC_Stun.desc: Strike the target with a stunning attack, briefly stopping their actions.

NPC_Venom.name: Venom
NPC_Venom.desc: The enemy coats its attacks in venom, applying Poison with each strike.

NPC_WideBleed.name: Wide Bleed
NPC_WideBleed.desc: Strike a wide area with bleeding force, leaving enemies wounded over time.

NPC_WideBlind.name: Wide Blind
NPC_WideBlind.desc: Blast a wide area with blinding force, reducing enemies' ability to fight accurately.

NPC_WideCurse.name: Wide Curse
NPC_WideCurse.desc: Curse enemies in a wide area, leaving them vulnerable to shadowed harm.

NPC_WideFreeze.name: Wide Freeze
NPC_WideFreeze.desc: Apply Frozen to enemies in a wide area, locking them in place with icy force.

NPC_WidePoison.name: Wide Poison
NPC_WidePoison.desc: Apply Poison to enemies in a wide area, wearing them down over time.

NPC_WideSilence.name: Wide Silence
NPC_WideSilence.desc: Silence enemies in a wide area, preventing them from casting skills.

NPC_WideStun.name: Wide Stun
NPC_WideStun.desc: Stun enemies in a wide area, stopping their actions for a short time.

PanicBurst.name: Panic Burst
PanicBurst.desc: Unleash a sudden burst of pistol fire, damaging nearby enemies and finishing prepared combos.

PiercingShot.name: Piercing Shot
PiercingShot.desc: Fire a piercing rifle round that punches through enemies, staggering and knocking them back.

PointBlankShot.name: Point Blank
PointBlankShot.desc: Fire a brutal close-range shotgun blast, blinding enemies and finishing shotgun combos.

PoisonField.name: Poison Ground
PoisonField.desc: Leave a toxic field behind, applying Poison to enemies and making them easier to damage.

PoisonGrenade.name: Poison Grenade
PoisonGrenade.desc: Hurl a toxic grenade that bursts into Poison, leaving deadly ground behind.

Reanimation.name: Reanimation
Reanimation.desc: Bind the lingering spirit of a fallen boss, claiming it as an undead champion.

Reap.name: Reap
Reap.desc: Carve through nearby enemies with a merciless scythe strike, pulling them in and siphoning HP.

ReapSummon.name: Reap
ReapSummon.desc: The summon radiates bloodlust, granting nearby allies HP siphon.

Revive.name: Resurrection
Revive.desc: Return a fallen ally to life, restoring a portion of their HP and spirit.

ReviveAll.name: Salvation
ReviveAll.desc: Call down celestial light, returning all fallen allies to life with renewed strength.

Sacrament.name: Sacrament
Sacrament.desc: Focus holy will into clarity, empowering Holy magic while improving Cast Speed and Status Duration.

SacredBlast.name: Sacred Blast
SacredBlast.desc: Create a holy sanctuary that heals allies over time and knocks enemies away.

SacredGround.name: Sacred Ground
SacredGround.desc: Hallow the ground beneath your allies, reducing damage taken from Ground Effects.

Sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
Sacrifice.desc: Offer your own HP to the divine, adding Holy damage to each of your blows.

Sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
Sanctuary.desc: Raise a sacred tree that heals allies and repels undead with holy radiance.

SanctuaryField.name: Litany of Sanctuary
SanctuaryField.desc: Create a small sanctuary of holy light, healing allies and pushing enemies away.

ShadowFeint.name: Elusive Feint
ShadowFeint.desc: Slip backward in a shadowy feint, briefly evading all attacks and leaving a clone behind.

ShadowRelease.name: Black Blade
ShadowRelease.desc: Launch a whirling crescent of darkness that carves through the target with shadow force.

ShadowSeal.name: Shadow Seal
ShadowSeal.desc: Split your presence through shadow, creating clones to fight alongside you.

ShadowStep.name: Shadow Step
ShadowStep.desc: Step through shadow to appear behind the target and strike.

ShadowStrike.name: Shadow Strike
ShadowStrike.desc: Strike the target with Shadow magic, cutting through them with dark force.

ShadowTrail.name: Shadow Trail
ShadowTrail.desc: Leave a cutting shadow in your wake, damaging nearby enemies and slowing their movement.

ShieldBash.name: Shield Bash
ShieldBash.desc: Charge! Brace that shield and lunge forth. Crumbling enemy defenses and opening them for further attacks.

ShieldThrow.name: Shield Throw
ShieldThrow.desc: Let the light guide your shield as you hurl it between many foes.

ShockAbsorber.name: Shock Absorber
ShockAbsorber.desc: Brace behind your shotgun, absorbing heavy impact and preventing flinching.

ShoutBlood.name: Blood Howl
ShoutBlood.desc: Unleash a savage howl that fills nearby allies with bloodlust and battle hunger.

ShoutFury.name: Furious Shout
ShoutFury.desc: Let out a furious battle cry, granting nearby allies Fury and sharpening their critical strikes.

ShoutMight.name: Mighty Roar
ShoutMight.desc: Let out a mighty roar, empowering nearby allies with increased strength.

ShoutMightLong.name: War Cry
ShoutMightLong.desc: Release an extended War Cry, granting Might to nearby allies for a longer duration.

ShoutStun.name: Fearsome Cry
ShoutStun.desc: Terrify nearby enemies with a savage cry, stunning them while fueling your Rage.

ShrapnelShot.name: Shrapnel
ShrapnelShot.desc: Blast enemies with close-range shrapnel, slowing and bleeding those caught in the burst.

ShurikenFan.name: Shuriken Fan
ShurikenFan.desc: Hurl a spinning shuriken that lingers in place, slicing nearby enemies again and again.

SilentEdge.name: Silent Edge
SilentEdge.desc: Enter a precise killing stance, increasing critical chance and Critical Damage.

SlowTrap.name: Slow Trap
SlowTrap.desc: Spread a shadowy trap across the ground, slowing enemies and leaving them vulnerable.

Smite.name: Smite
Smite.desc: Strike the target with holy force, dealing blessed damage with a chance to stun.

SmokeScreen.name: Smoke Screen
SmokeScreen.desc: Create a blinding smoke screen, blinding enemies while cloaking yourself.

SmokeScreenAlly.name: Smoke Screen
SmokeScreenAlly.desc: Cover allies in smoke, cloaking them from sight for a short time.

SniperNest.name: Sniper's Nest
SniperNest.desc: Take a steady sniper stance, increasing Ranged damage and Critical Damage while greatly reducing movement.

SniperShot.name: Sniper Shot
SniperShot.desc: Line up a devastating rifle shot, striking with heavy precision damage.

SoulDrain.name: Soul Drain
SoulDrain.desc: The summon radiates a draining aura, helping nearby allies siphon HP and MP from battle.

SoulDrainEnemy.name: Soul Drain Enemy
SoulDrainEnemy.desc: Mark enemies with soul drain, raising undead summons when they fall.

SoulStrike.name: Soul Strike
SoulStrike.desc: Launch a focused burst of Soul magic at a single enemy.

SpearQuicken.name: Spear Quicken
SpearQuicken.desc: Through disciplined weapon training, the Knight strikes faster and cleaner. Fear the one who has practiced the same technique a thousand times.

SpearSlice.name: Air Cutter
SpearSlice.desc: A wide sweeping attack, staggering enemies and making them more susceptible to attacks.

SpearStab.name: Impale
SpearStab.desc: Finish them with a strong piercing attack. Increased damage when used as part of a combo.

SpearThrust.name: Piercing Flurry
SpearThrust.desc: Open with rapid piercing strikes, cutting through enemies and preparing your next combo.

SpellShield.name: Arcanum Ward
SpellShield.desc: Wrap an ally in a sacred ward that reflects Magic damage before hostile spells can reach them.

StatusRecovery.name: Status Recovery
StatusRecovery.desc: Clear Stun, Frozen, Burning, and Decay from an ally, granting brief immunity to each.

Stomp.name: Stomp
Stomp.desc: Slam the ground with heavy force, stunning enemies caught in the impact.

StrafingVolley.name: Strafing Volley
StrafingVolley.desc: Fire a rapid volley of arrows into a single target.

SummonAbomination.name: Summon Abomination
SummonAbomination.desc: Summon a stitched mass of decaying flesh, built to control space through brute force.

SummonAngel.name: Summon Angel
SummonAngel.desc: Summon a radiant healer who restores allies and strikes enemies with holy light.

SummonAttack.name: Summon Command
SummonAttack.desc: Command your active summons to converge on the chosen target and attack.

SummonCactus.name: Summon Cactus
SummonCactus.desc: Summon a spiny sentinel that absorbs punishment and strikes back without flinching.

SummonCat.name: Summon Cat
SummonCat.desc: Summon a nimble caster that darts through battle and blasts enemies with lightning.

SummonDeathMage.name: Summon Death Mage
SummonDeathMage.desc: Summon an undead demon who strengthens necromantic power and commands dark magic.

SummonMount.name: Summon Mount
SummonMount.desc: Mount your active summon, taking direct control from a stronger battlefield position.

SummonReanimation.name: Summon Reanimation
SummonReanimation.desc: Call forth a claimed undead champion, returning it to the battlefield.

SummonRecall.name: Summon Recall
SummonRecall.desc: Recall your active summons, cancelling their actions and bringing them back to your side.

SummonSkeleton.name: Summon Skeleton
SummonSkeleton.desc: Raise a Bonekin to fight beside you as the backbone of your undead army.

SummonSkeletonMage.name: Summon Skeleton Mage
SummonSkeletonMage.desc: Raise a Bonecaster that attacks from range with unstable necromantic magic.

SummonSwap.name: Summon Swap
SummonSwap.desc: Swap your active summon setup, adapting quickly to the fight.

SummonWolf.name: Summon Wolf
SummonWolf.desc: Summon a fast, feral brawler that tears into enemies with raw strength and speed.

SummonWraith.name: Summon Wraith
SummonWraith.desc: Summon a ghostly undead caster that harasses enemies with dark magic.

SuppressiveShot.name: Suppressive Shot
SuppressiveShot.desc: Fire suppressive shots that weaken and mark enemies, setting them up for follow-up attacks.

Taunt.name: Taunt
Taunt.desc: Compels inflicted targets to focus their attention on you. Increases Threat generation.

Tempest.name: Tempest
Tempest.desc: Summon a furious gale that batters enemies, blinds them, and exposes them to Water damage.

TetraVortex.name: Elemental Overload
TetraVortex.desc: Unleash a massive elemental eruption based on your current attunement, overwhelming enemies in a wide area.

TetraVortexEarth.name: Overload Earth
TetraVortexEarth.desc: Shatter the ground with Elemental Overload, dealing repeated Earth damage and heavily slowing enemies.

TetraVortexFire.name: Overload Fire
TetraVortexFire.desc: Ignite the battlefield with Elemental Overload, dealing repeated Fire damage and burning enemies.

TetraVortexWater.name: Overload Ice
TetraVortexWater.desc: Freeze the battlefield with Elemental Overload, dealing repeated Water damage and locking enemies in place.

TetraVortexWind.name: Overload Wind
TetraVortexWind.desc: Tear open the storm with Elemental Overload, dealing repeated Wind damage and stunning enemies.

Thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
Thunderbolt.desc: Call down a focused bolt of lightning on one enemy and attune yourself to Wind.

ThunderField.name: Static Field
ThunderField.desc: Leave crackling energy on the ground, shocking enemies and exposing them to Water.

ThunderStorm.name: Thunder Storm
ThunderStorm.desc: Call down a storm of lightning over an area, striking enemies and exposing them to Water damage.

TriggerHappy.name: Trigger Happy
TriggerHappy.desc: Enter a wild firing state, automatically shooting nearby enemies while moving.

TrueSight.name: True Sight
TrueSight.desc: Reveal hidden enemies with holy sight, exposing them for a short time.

TurnUndead.name: Turn Undead
TurnUndead.desc: Attempt to purge Undead and Shadow enemies with divine judgment, dealing massive damage on success.

TwistOfFate.name: Twist Of Fate
TwistOfFate.desc: Strike with overwhelming force, stunning and scattering enemies before slipping back into shadows.

TwohandQuicken.name: Axe Quicken
TwohandQuicken.desc: Sharpen your battle rhythm, increasing Attack Speed and critical chance for a short time.

UmbralExplosion.name: Umbral Rupture
UmbralExplosion.desc: Rupture the area with umbral force, marking enemies so they take increased damage.

UmbralField.name: Umbral Decay
UmbralField.desc: Spread lingering umbral decay beneath enemies, damaging them and marking them with shadow.

UmbralWide.name: Umbral Collapse
UmbralWide.desc: Collapse umbral energy across a wide area, marking enemies so incoming attacks hit harder.

UnholyAura.name: Unholy Aura
UnholyAura.desc: The summon radiates unholy power, increasing nearby allies' Undead and Shadow damage.

Unyielding.name: Unyielding
Unyielding.desc: Consume Rage to steel your body, reducing incoming damage through sheer will.

VenomBloom.name: Venom Bloom
VenomBloom.desc: Burst venom around the target, damaging nearby enemies and stacking Poison.

VenomCoating.name: Venom Coating
VenomCoating.desc: Coat your attacks in venom, giving each strike a chance to apply Poison.

VenomStrike.name: Venom Strike
VenomStrike.desc: Strike twice with venomous force, with a chance to apply Poison.

Vitality.name: Vitality Aura
Vitality.desc: Emit a gentle divine aura, increasing Vitality and HP recovery for nearby allies.

VolatileBolt.name: Volatile Bolt
VolatileBolt.desc: Fire a volatile shot that explodes on impact, damaging enemies around the target.

VolatileExplosion.name: Volatile Explosion
VolatileExplosion.desc: Detonate volatile energy, damaging nearby enemies and leaving them vulnerable.

WaterBarrier.name: Avatar of Frost
WaterBarrier.desc: Mastery over Water lets you assume this avatar state. Increasing Water damage, MP Regen, and freezing those that dare attack you.

WeaponSwap.name: Dual Loadout
WeaponSwap.desc: Swap between equipped loadouts, adapting your combat style in the middle of battle.

WeaponThrow.name: Weapon Throw
WeaponThrow.desc: Hurl your weapon with precision, slowing your target while you attack from afar.

Whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
Whirlwind.desc: Spin in place with relentless force, striking all nearby enemies over time.

WildCharge.name: Wild Charge
WildCharge.desc: Leap forward with ferocious momentum, crushing enemies and fueling your Rage.

WindBarrier.name: Avatar of Storm
WindBarrier.desc: Mastery over Wind lets you assume this avatar state. Increasing your Move Speed and discharging a blast of lightning at those that dare attack you.

Zeal.name: Zeal
Zeal.desc: Inspire an ally with fervent conviction, greatly increasing their damage for a time.
